messages:
alex: quick sync — noticed a correctness gap in read-repair during prefix ownership handoff + compaction. can we chat?

maria: summary pls — what triggers it?

alex: short version: handoff finishes and the old owner compacts away tombstone entries before a read-repair from a follower applies a rollback. follower sees keys that should be tombstoned but the compaction removed the tombstone -> stale reads. seems timing + compaction window.

jordan: ouch. is this the case where we fast-path demote -> compact immediately without waiting for any commit-ack?

alex: yep. demote triggers a compact on the slab, and if the new owner hasn't applied the read-repair/rollback we lose the barrier.

maria: possible fixes: 1) keep tombstones for X extra ms after handoff 2) include an epoch/token in handoff so compaction checks it 3) make read-repair idempotent and guarded by ownership tokens. pros/cons?

jordan: 1) simple but brittle (timing). 2) looks promising: compaction consults active handoff tokens. 3) idempotent read-repair is nice but follower still needs to know whether to push rollback if tombstone gone.

alex: my spike idea: extend handoff to return a compact-safety token that lives in memory (and in small GCable index). compaction checks tokens for that prefix/epoch and will skip deleting tombstones until token cleared. read-repair includes token so rollback is accepted even if tombstone later disappears.

maria: ok show pseudocode for token shape?

alex: ```json
{"handoff_epoch": 98765, "commit_token": "uuid-6f1e", "prefix": "tenant/123"}
```

alex: flow: 1) old owner starts handoff, writes token 2) new owner applies state and performs read-repair referencing token 3) once new owner acks stable, orchestration clears token 4) compaction honors token TTL/GC and won't remove tombstones until cleared or TTL expires.

jordan: memory/leak concerns: tokens could pile up if orchestration fails. need TTL + periodic GC + metric. also compaction must be cheap to check — probably a bloom or small in-memory hash per shard.

ev an-bot: deploybot: plan: create spike branch + small test that races handoff/compaction with read-repair; assign owner. link: <https://stash.internal/r/redwood/kv/compare/hand-off-readrepair-spike>

maria: +1 to spike. owner: @alex? estimate a day to validate race and add simple metrics (token-count, token-ttl-expirations, compaction-skips).

alex: taking it. I'll add metrics and a microbench. also add an integration test that fuzzes compaction timing.

jordan: add an operational kill-switch flag to revert compaction behavior if we see token leak in prod.

ev an-bot: noted. opening a ticket in tracker: TRACK-4521 (kv: handoff read-repair token spike).

maria: sgtm. thanks — keep updates in the PR and drop a note in #eng-runtime when the spike is ready for review. :thumbsup:

alex: will do.
